messages.subject: RE: Advice note — Marsden
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah — Rebecca, Helen and I have read your advice note. We're comfortable settling rather than litigating given the whistleblowing exposure you flag. You have authority up to £115k all-in. Please push hard on the non-compete — protecting our customer relationships matters more to us than the last few thousand pounds.

Gavin
